segments.name: open-app
segments.narration: This is the plan list before any of the work lands.

segments.name: context
segments.narration: First, where things stand today. Plan chapters have no video anchor.

segments.name: outcome
segments.narration: Here is what changes. Every chapter names the range it runs in.

segments.name: approach
segments.narration: The approach is two steps. Step one. Record the chapter on the step.

segments.name: approach-detail
segments.narration: Step two. Derive the range from the steps that carry the chapter.

segments.name: risks
segments.narration: Now the risks. An old timeline carries no chapter, so it seeks by step.

segments.name: decision
segments.narration: That is the plan. You can approve it, or redirect with changes.
